title: Simulating Insider Threat Scenarios: Do Agents Exfiltrate Data When Given Opportunity?

original_idea.body:
# Simulating Insider Threat Scenarios: Do Agents Exfiltrate Data When Given Opportunity?

**Problem:** AI agents acting as insider threats could exfiltrate sensitive information when given the opportunity. No controlled study has characterized the conditions under which current models exhibit this behavior.

**Direction:** Create a simulated office environment where an agent has access to sensitive files and outbound communication channels. Under various system prompts (neutral, subtly adversarial, goal-hijacked), measure the rate at which agents attempt information exfiltration.

**Why it matters:** Understanding the conditions that trigger exfiltration-like behavior helps inform monitoring policy and agent deployment constraints.

**Relevant context:** AI insider threat literature (Proofpoint, Palo Alto 2026); Anthropic real espionage campaign disruption.
